name: SmartTag
description: Represents a smart tag that has been added to a control on a form or report. The SmartTag object is a member of the SmartTags collection.
remarks: To return a single SmartTag object, use the Item property of the SmartTags collection, or use SmartTags (_index_), where _index_ represents the number of the smart tag. To return the collection of actions available for the smart tag, use the SmartTagActions property. To perform a smart tag action, use the Execute method of the SmartTagAction object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Use the Application property to access the active Microsoft Access Application object and its related properties. Read-only Application object.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Use the Name property to determine the string expression that identifies the name of an object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Properties
properties.description: Returns a SmartTagProperties collection that represents the collection of properties for a particular smart tag. Read-only.

properties.name: SmartTagActions
properties.description: Returns a SmartTagActions collection that represents the actions available for a specific smart tag. Read-only.

properties.name: XML
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the related XML code for a smart tag. Read-only.

properties.name: IsMissing
properties.description: Returns True if the specified smart tag is not installed or is installed incorrectly. Read-only Boolean.
